review.rationale: The TITMAS CE-G13 offline contract package decision strictly adheres to the standing directive, maintains a precise 28-file scope with zero executables or network clients, enforces comprehensive offline validation (including 24+ negative cases, Draft 2020-12 schema compliance, role specialization, and prompt hash binding), and explicitly prohibits all execution, customer, commercial, and authority elevations. The recommendation chain is intact and remote-verified, the package manifest hash rule is enforced, and the commit gate is fail-closed. All non-authorizations are correctly bounded, preserving architectural governance and offline-only constraints.
